evidence.quote: Course highlights are the short duration (seven semesters = three and a half years) and the intensive support given to the students.

The Bachelor's program in Mechanical Engineering / International Project Engineering is designed as a full-time study course with a duration of 7 semesters, always starting in the summer semester (beginning of March).
The regular model is a bilingual program. The course languages are English (semesters 1-4) and German (semesters 5-7).
The course language is English (semesters 1 through 4) and later German (semesters 5 through 7).

In Baden-Württemberg, as of the winter semester 2017/2018, all international students (non-EU citizens) and students who are taking up a second degree also have to pay a tuition fee of 1.500 EUR per semester.
All students who do not come from the EU pay tuition fees of 1,500 euros for each semester.
APPLICATION PERIOD FOR THE SUMMER INTAKE 2027: 1 December, 2026 - 15 january, 2027

B.Eng. Mechanical Engineering/ International Project Engineering summer 2027 intake, bilingual: taught in English in semesters 1-4 & German in semesters 5-7, (NB: Application period for International Project Engineering 1 December to 15 January the following year)
1. ONLINE APPLICATION: The RWU provides an online application tool for you to submit your initial submission, opening 1 December, 2026 and closing 15 January, 2027.
Proven English skills e.g. TOEFL iBT with a total score of min. 70 or IELTS with an overall band score of min. 6.0 - Medium of Instruction Certificates and TOEFL Home Edition are not accepted!
Very good Mathematic skills and good knowledge in any other science subjects (physics, computer science, etc.)

note.en: Your diploma (Moroccan Bac) must be recognised as equivalent to the German higher education entrance qualification (HZB) by the Studienkolleg Konstanz; this recognition must be obtained before applying.

note.en: The official recognition of the diploma by the Studienkolleg Konstanz must be submitted by 31 August 2026 at the latest.

evidence.quote: The recognition has to be submitted on 31. August 2026, at the latest.

notes: The DAAD page lists a tuition fee of 1,500 EUR per semester for applicants from non-EU countries, and the RWU pages confirm this; a more general statement ('All students who do not come from the EU pay tuition fees of 1,500 euros for each semester') also covers non-EU citizens, so the same figure is used. The special model M (Malaysia) is a separate track; the fee quoted is the university's statutory fee for non-EU citizens. The application deadline 15 January 2027 is specific to this programme (the general German-taught English bachelor deadlines differ), and it is stated for all applicants regardless of origin; for a Moroccan applicant applying with a foreign qualification, the same deadline applies. Document list: the 'School-leaving certificate' item quotes a sentence that also says the document needs an official translation into English or German, hence translationRequired=true; other documents are not stated to require translation.
